youtube.title: Napoleon couldn't wait. So he crowned HIMSELF 👑 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon didn't wait for anyone. Not even the crown 👑

What would YOU have done if you were holding that crown? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: at his coronation in Notre-Dame on 2 December 1804, with Pope Pius VII present, Napoleon placed the imperial crown on his own head, then crowned Josephine. Historians say the move was agreed in advance, not a sudden grab.
